lines.text: Two brand new engines run with no oil until they blow up and each one only has an oil additive inside.
One gets STP and the other gets Lucas because thousands of viewers asked for this fight.
First the friction tester shows both pure additives leave a smaller scar than plain oil and pure STP scars the least.
Both are mostly thick petroleum oil so they cling to metal and keep a film between the parts.
beats: ai:a thin golden film of oil between two sliding steel parts macro

lines.text: Then he drains every drop of oil and starts both engines together which is the cruelest test you can do.
The STP engine starts smoking and knocking first and then the Lucas engine starts knocking too.
Without oil the metal parts heat up from friction until the connecting rod tears itself apart.
beats: ai:a red hot glowing engine connecting rod and crankshaft in a dark engine block

lines.text: Inside the STP engine the rod is in pieces and the aluminum got so hot it melted.
And the Lucas engine exploded too so no additive can save an engine that has no oil.
So which one would you put in your engine?
